item.title: Show HN: Blade – a terminal UI for starting and supervising project commands
item.summary: Just wanted to share a little utility I made to scratch my own itch. Having worked on a multi-repo setup, starting a project was sometimes a bit of a chore and having a lot of terminal windows open can sometimes be annoying. It could've been done with tmux probably, but it was a fun exercise for me :-) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49367646 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
